name: Richard Le Gallienne
bio: Poet, critic and man of the nineties, born in Liverpool and for a time reader to John Lane at the Bodley Head - the firm that published Wilde. He was a conspicuous ornament of the period, long-haired and much photographed, and Wilde wrote to him across a decade: fourteen letters survive in the Complete Letters, running from the mid-1880s to the mid-1890s. The warmest is of December 1890, on Le Gallienne's book about Meredith. He married three times, moved to the United States in 1901 and died at Menton in 1947.
